_comment: Copy to infra/params.json, fill in the secrets, and deploy:
az deployment group create -g sift-rg -f infra/main.bicep -p @infra/params.json
params.json is gitignored because postgresAdminPassword and azureOpenAiKey are real
credentials. Every parameter here has a default in main.bicep except the password.
The Azure OpenAI account is not created by this template - it is provisioned by hand
in East US, where the model quota lives - so its endpoint and key are inputs.
